Questions

Answers before you call.

Is M&S the same as Miller's Tree Service?

Yes. A lot of customers know us as Miller's Tree Service or Miller Tree Service, after owner Miller Navarro. The business name is M&S Tree Service, and it's the same crew and the same number, (361) 548-4857.

Are your estimates free?

Yes. Call or text, and Miller or the office will come look at the trees and give you a price. No charge.

Are you insured?

Yes. M&S Tree Service is insured and bonded.

Do you take credit cards?

Yes, we take credit cards.

Do you answer after hours?

Yes, for emergencies. The phone is answered 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, because storm damage doesn't wait for business hours. Regular tree work is scheduled during the day.

Do you haul everything off?

Yes. Limbs go through the chipper on site, logs go on the truck, and the yard gets raked before we leave.

Can I get references?

Yes. Miller has plenty of customers who are happy to talk. Ask when you call.
